ev.q: Novavax COVID-19 Vaccine in Persons Aged ≥18 years
Subgroup analyses by age demonstrated VE against RT-PCR–confirmed symptomatic COVID-19 of 90.3% (95% CI = 83.1%–94.4%) among participants aged 18–64 years
VE in participants of Hispanic or Latino (Hispanic) ethnicity was lower (75.7%; 95% CI = 46.0%–89.1%).

equity.equity_measurement: All SPD results (VE by age and ethnicity, intent by race and sex) are cited from the manufacturer trial or an earlier survey.

notes: ACIP GRADE evidence summary; efficacy and safety figures are cited from the manufacturer trial and postmarketing reports. The Work Group's own RRs for GRADE (VE = 100 × (1 − RR)) are arithmetic and not shown; the manufacturer's modified Poisson model is not the article's own procedure. Immunobridging noninferiority (GMR CI vs 0.67) is likewise cited.
